column3: Step 1, before any photo. Read aloud to ask the farmer's permission.
column4: May I photograph some coffee leaves on your farm? The photos stay on this phone. We keep your co-op number in coded form, not your name. The officer may look at the photos. You can say no, or ask us to delete them later.
column5: Je, naweza kupiga picha za majani ya kahawa shambani mwako? Picha zitabaki kwenye simu hii. Hatuhifadhi jina lako. Tunahifadhi namba yako ya uanachama katika chama cha ushirika tu, na tunaiweka kuwa siri. Afisa wa ugani anaweza kuziangalia picha hizi. Unaweza kukataa, au kutuomba tuzifute baadaye.

column3: Step 3, end-of-visit summary. Warning box.
column4: This tool can be wrong. It gives a first look only. The extension officer makes the final call.
column5: Programu hii inaweza kukosea. Inatoa jibu la awali tu. Afisa wa ugani ndiye atakayefanya uamuzi wa mwisho.

column3: Answer after a photo, when the tool is not sure.
column4: Not sure. The tool cannot tell from this photo. The photo is saved for the officer to look at.
column5: Sina uhakika. Siwezi kutambua kutoka kwenye picha hii. Picha imehifadhiwa ili afisa wa ugani aiangalie.

column3: What to do, under a "not sure" answer.
column4: Put a mark on this tree. The officer will review the saved photo. Do not spray because of this result. Wait for the officer's advice first.
column5: Weka alama kwenye mti huu. Afisa wa ugani ataangalia picha iliyohifadhiwa. Usinyunyize dawa kwa sababu ya matokeo haya. Subiri ushauri wa afisa kwanza.

column3: What to do, under a "healthy" answer.
column4: Keep up good care. Prune on time, weed, and feed the trees as advised. Check again at the next visit.
column5: Endelea kutunza vizuri. Pogoa kwa wakati, ondoa magugu, na weka mbolea kama ulivyoshauriwa. Kagua tena katika ziara ijayo.

column3: What to do, under a "leaf rust" answer.
column4: Mark this tree. Prune so air and light reach the leaves. Ask the extension officer about approved rust control before the rains.
column5: Weka alama kwenye mti huu. Pogoa matawi ili hewa na mwanga vifikie majani. Muulize afisa wa ugani kuhusu njia zilizoidhinishwa za kudhibiti kutu kabla ya mvua.

column3: What to do, under a "leaf miner" answer.
column4: Mark this tree. Small wasps kill many leaf miners, so do not spray without advice. Ask the extension officer what to do.
column5: Weka alama kwenye mti huu. Nyigu wadogo huua wadudu wengi wa aina hii, kwa hiyo usinyunyize dawa bila ushauri. Muulize afisa wa ugani hatua za kuchukua.

column3: What to do, under a "brown eye spot" answer.
column4: Brown eye spot is common on weak, underfed trees. Ask the officer about a soil test and feeding. Mulch to keep soil moist.
column5: Ugonjwa wa madoa ya kahawia hutokea sana kwenye miti dhaifu isiyo na mbolea ya kutosha. Muulize afisa wa ugani kuhusu kupima udongo, na kuhusu mbolea inayofaa. Weka matandazo ili udongo ubaki na unyevu.

column3: What to do, under a "Phoma leaf spot" answer.
column4: Phoma is worse in cold, windy weather on high ground. Windbreak and shade trees can help. Ask the extension officer about approved control.
column5: Ugonjwa wa Phoma huzidi wakati wa baridi na upepo mkali katika maeneo ya juu. Miti ya kuzuia upepo na miti ya kivuli inaweza kusaidia. Muulize afisa wa ugani kuhusu njia zilizoidhinishwa za kudhibiti ugonjwa huu.

column3: Answer after a photo: leaf rust.
column4: This looks like coffee leaf rust. Rust shows as yellow-orange powder under the leaf. The extension officer makes the final call.
column5: Hii inaonekana kama ugonjwa wa kutu ya majani ya kahawa. Kutu huonekana kama unga wa manjano au rangi ya chungwa chini ya jani. Afisa wa ugani ndiye atakayefanya uamuzi wa mwisho.

column3: Answer after a photo: leaf miner.
column4: This looks like leaf miner damage. It shows as dry brown patches on the leaf. The extension officer makes the final call.
column5: Hii inaonekana kama uharibifu wa wadudu wanaochimba ndani ya majani. Huonekana kama sehemu kubwa kavu za rangi ya kahawia kwenye jani. Afisa wa ugani ndiye atakayefanya uamuzi wa mwisho.

column3: Answer after a photo: brown eye spot.
column4: This looks like brown eye spot. It shows as round brown spots with a pale centre. The extension officer makes the final call.
column5: Hii inaonekana kama ugonjwa wa madoa ya kahawia. Huonekana kama madoa ya mviringo ya kahawia, yenye rangi nyeupe katikati. Afisa wa ugani ndiye atakayefanya uamuzi wa mwisho.

column3: Answer after a photo: Phoma leaf spot.
column4: This looks like Phoma leaf spot. It shows as dark patches, often on young leaves after cold weather. The extension officer makes the final call.
column5: Hii inaonekana kama ugonjwa wa Phoma. Huonekana kama madoa meusi, mara nyingi kwenye majani machanga baada ya baridi. Afisa wa ugani ndiye atakayefanya uamuzi wa mwisho.

column3: Answer after a photo: healthy leaf.
column4: These leaves look healthy. No sign of rust, leaf miner or leaf spot was seen. This check covers leaves only, not berries.
column5: Majani haya yanaonekana kuwa na afya. Hakuna dalili ya kutu, wadudu wanaochimba ndani ya majani, wala madoa ya ugonjwa. Ukaguzi huu ni wa majani tu, si wa matunda.

column3: When a photo is too dark or blurry.
column4: Please take the photo again. Show the underside of one leaf, in daylight. Hold the phone still.
column5: Tafadhali piga picha tena. Onyesha upande wa chini wa jani moja, kwenye mwanga wa mchana. Shika simu bila kutikisa.

column3: Step 3 summary card: all photos look healthy.
column4: All photos from this plot look healthy. Keep checking at each visit. Leaf photos cannot show berry problems.
column5: Majani katika picha zote za shamba hili yanaonekana kuwa na afya. Endelea kukagua katika kila ziara. Picha za majani haziwezi kuonyesha matatizo ya matunda.

column3: Step 3 summary card: 1-2 photos show a problem.
column4: Some photos show a possible problem. Please show this card to the extension officer.
column5: Baadhi ya picha zinaonyesha kwamba huenda kuna tatizo. Tafadhali mwonyeshe afisa wa ugani kadi hii.

column3: Step 3 summary card: problem on several trees.
column4: There may be a problem on several trees in this plot. Please show this card to the extension officer soon. The officer decides what to do.
column5: Huenda kuna tatizo kwenye miti kadhaa katika shamba hili. Tafadhali mwonyeshe afisa wa ugani kadi hii mapema. Afisa ndiye ataamua hatua za kuchukua.

column3: Step 3 checklist (not AI), question 1. Farmer answers yes/no.
column4: Are most trees old, with few new branches? If yes, ask the officer about stumping to renew them.
column5: Je, miti mingi imezeeka, na ina matawi mapya machache? Kama ndiyo, muulize afisa wa ugani kuhusu kukata mashina ili miti ichipue upya.

column3: Step 3 checklist (not AI), question 2.
column4: Has the coffee gone without manure or fertiliser this year? If yes, ask the co-op about a soil test first.
column5: Je, kahawa imekosa mbolea ya samadi au mbolea ya dukani mwaka huu? Kama ndiyo, uliza chama cha ushirika kuhusu kupima udongo kwanza.

column3: Step 3 checklist (not AI), question 3.
column4: Are there many weeds under the coffee? If yes, weed before feeding the trees. Weeds take water and food.
column5: Je, kuna magugu mengi chini ya kahawa? Kama ndiyo, ondoa magugu kabla ya kuweka mbolea. Magugu huchukua maji na chakula cha mimea.

column3: Step 3 checklist (not AI), question 4.
column4: Do green berries have dark, sunken spots? This may be coffee berry disease. Show the extension officer soon.
column5: Je, matunda mabichi yana madoa meusi yaliyozama ndani? Huenda ni ugonjwa wa matunda ya kahawa. Mwonyeshe afisa wa ugani mapema.

column3: Step 3 checklist (not AI), question 5.
column4: Do berries have a small round hole near the tip? This may be berry borer. Collect fallen berries and tell the officer.
column5: Je, matunda yana tundu dogo la mviringo karibu na ncha? Huenda ni mdudu anayetoboa matunda. Okota matunda yaliyoanguka na umwambie afisa wa ugani.

column3: Step 3 checklist (not AI), question 6.
column4: Was there a long dry spell during flowering? That can mean fewer berries. Mulch helps keep the soil moist.
column5: Je, kulikuwa na kiangazi kirefu wakati wa kuchanua maua? Hilo linaweza kusababisha matunda machache. Matandazo husaidia udongo kubaki na unyevu.
